input.overview: Butterfly is a bonus-first game. Build base bonus to 100,000 with the upper saucer and safer top-return lanes, then complete the angled center three-bank and roll through a lit side return lane for Double Bonus. Repeated bank completions also raise the targets from 100 to 1,000 to 10,000 each.
input.simpleOverview: Build bonus with the upper saucer and safe shots back to the top. Complete the angled three-bank to light Double Bonus at the side return lanes, then roll through one of those lit lanes.
input.summary: Use the right flipper for repeatable up-top shots, max the base before risking the center bank, then collect Double Bonus through a lit side return lane.

quickInfo.name: Build Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Use the top-center lane, upper saucer, upper-right lane, or lit bonus switches.

quickInfo.name: Collect Double
quickInfo.summary: Roll through the right return lane or outer-left return lane when lit.

quickInfo.name: Raise Drops
quickInfo.summary: Bank completions raise each drop from 100 to 1,000 to 10,000.

steps.text: Use the right flipper to send the ball up the left arc or into the upper saucer and build base bonus toward 100,000.
After the base is valuable, complete the angled center three-bank to light Double Bonus.
Return the ball to the top so it can feed the lit right or outer-left return lane and activate Double Bonus.
Continue up top; avoid direct standup shots whose rebounds threaten the drain.

alternatives.title: Drop-value ladder
alternatives.when: Use this when the bank rebounds are predictable and Double Bonus is already secured.

steps.text: Complete the three-bank once to raise each drop to 1,000.
Complete it again to raise each drop to 10,000 and light Extra Ball at the left arc if enabled.
Take further bank shots only while their returns remain controlled.
Max the base bonus through upper routes.
Complete the three-bank to qualify Double Bonus.
Roll through a lit side return lane and preserve the 200,000 end-of-ball payout.

machineSetup: Test the upper saucer and eject, three-bank reset and value lamps, both Double Bonus return lanes, bonus ladder, left Extra Ball arc, and asymmetric lower-lane feeds.
Confirm Extra Ball conversion and which top plunge lane produces the safer return on this copy.

playfieldReferences.label: Upper bonus saucer
playfieldReferences.description: Upper-left saucer that advances bonus and scores its lit-light total.

playfieldReferences.label: Double Bonus drop bank
playfieldReferences.description: Three-bank that qualifies Double Bonus and raises its own value.

playfieldReferences.label: Double Bonus return lanes
playfieldReferences.description: Right and outer-left lower lanes that activate Double Bonus when lit.

cautions.issue: The safest plunge and saucer feeds vary by copy, and the lower playfield is asymmetric.
cautions.response: Watch one plunge and one saucer eject before committing; transfer from the left flipper to the right when the feed permits it.
